codes.name: Request for payment
codes.description: Document/message issued by a creditor to a debtor to request payment of one or more invoices past due.

codes.name: Debit note related to goods or services
codes.description: Debit information related to a transaction for goods or services to the relevant party.

codes.name: Metered services invoice
codes.description: Document/message claiming payment for the supply of metered services (e.g., gas, electricity, etc.) supplied to a fixed meter whose consumption is measured over a period of time.

codes.name: Debit note related to financial adjustments
codes.description: Document/message for providing debit information related to financial adjustments to the relevant party.

codes.name: Tax notification
codes.description: Used to specify that the message is a tax notification.

codes.name: Final payment request based on completion of work
codes.description: The final payment request of a series of payment requests submitted upon completion of all the work.

codes.name: Payment request for completed units
codes.description: A request for payment for completed units.

codes.name: Partial invoice
codes.description: Document/message specifying details of an incomplete invoice.

codes.name: Commercial invoice which includes a packing list
codes.description: Commercial transaction (invoice) will include a packing list.

codes.name: Commercial invoice
codes.description: (1334) Document/message claiming payment for goods or services supplied under conditions agreed between seller and buyer.

codes.name: Commission note
codes.description: Document/message in which a seller specifies the amount of commission, the percentage of the invoice amount, or some other basis for the calculation of the commission to which a sales agent is entitled.

codes.name: Debit note
codes.description: Document/message for providing debit information to the relevant party.

codes.name: Corrected invoice
codes.description: Commercial invoice that includes revised information differing from an earlier submission of the same invoice.

codes.name: Prepayment invoice
codes.description: An invoice to pay amounts for goods and services in advance; these amounts will be subtracted from the final invoice.

codes.name: Tax invoice
codes.description: An invoice for tax purposes.

codes.name: Self-billed invoice
codes.description: An invoice the invoicee is producing instead of the seller.

codes.name: Factored invoice
codes.description: Invoice assigned to a third party for collection.

codes.name: Consignment invoice
codes.description: Commercial invoice that covers a transaction other than one involving a sale.

codes.name: Forwarder's invoice discrepancy report
codes.description: Document/message reporting invoice discrepancies indentified by the forwarder.

codes.name: Insurer's invoice
codes.description: Document/message issued by an insurer specifying the cost of an insurance which has been effected and claiming payment therefore.

codes.name: Forwarder's invoice
codes.description: Invoice issued by a freight forwarder specifying services rendered and costs incurred and claiming payment therefore.

codes.name: Freight invoice
codes.description: Document/message issued by a transport operation specifying freight costs and charges incurred for a transport operation and stating conditions of payment.

codes.name: Claim notification
codes.description: Document notifying a claim.

codes.name: Consular invoice
codes.description: Document/message to be prepared by an exporter in his country and presented to a diplomatic representation of the importing country for endorsement and subsequently to be presented by the importer in connection with the import of the goods described therein.

codes.name: Partial construction invoice
codes.description: Partial invoice in the context of a specific construction project.

codes.name: Partial final construction invoice
codes.description: Invoice concluding all previous partial construction invoices of a completed partial rendered service in the context of a specific construction project.

codes.name: Final construction invoice
codes.description: Invoice concluding all previous partial invoices and partial final construction invoices in the context of a specific construction project.
